message.content:
I need screens and buttons to:

- **View and assign drones** to jobs or charging, showing their status (in flight, charging, out of service) and which sites they’re at.
- **Start and stop charging** for drones at our pads, with buttons to send instructions—even if they sometimes fail or repeat.
- **Mark drones as out of service** for repairs and put them back when fixed, so dispatchers don’t use them.
- **Add new drones** to the fleet and retire old ones, updating their home sites and connectors.
- **See which pads are free** at our sites so I can send drones there to charge without mixing up connectors.
- **Check reports from drones** even if they’re late, missing, or duplicated, to confirm they arrived safely and data is valid.
